title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Compare Auckland gyms, prices and contracts, find your best fit and start your fitness journey today easily
intro: Aucklanders have plenty of gym options to choose from, with prices ranging from $15 to $50 per week. With so many choices, it can be hard to decide which gym is best for you. In this guide, we'll break down the best gyms in Auckland by suburb, including their prices and contract terms.

sections.heading: Top Gyms in Auckland CBD
sections.body: If you work in the city, a CBD gym can be a convenient option. Some popular choices include Snap Fitness, which costs $24.95 per week with a 12-month contract, and Anytime Fitness, which costs $29.95 per week with a 12-month contract.

sections.heading: Gyms in North Shore
list: Les Mills North Shore: $24.95 per week with a 12-month contract
Fitness First Takapuna: $29.95 per week with a 12-month contract
Jetts Gym Northcote: $14.95 per week with a no-contract option

sections.heading: Commuter Gyms
sections.body: If you're looking for a gym to visit on your way to or from work, consider a gym with 24/7 access. Both Anytime Fitness and Snap Fitness offer 24/7 access, with prices starting at $29.95 per week and $24.95 per week respectively.

sections.heading: Gyms with Parking
list: Fitness First Newmarket: free parking available
Les Mills Auckland City: paid parking available nearby
Jetts Gym Manukau: free parking available
